meaning: Read-only completeness and cached-vector sensitivity diagnostics. Not semantic validation, curriculum equivalence, rankings, admission predictions or alumni/career analysis.

embeddingCache.warning: The cache predates the recent source corrections, includes school/location/degree/language boilerplate, and does not store per-record text hashes. Current-input freshness cannot be verified. No new embeddings generated.

publishedGraph.method: school-mean-removed cosine; similar if same subject group & >= 0.33, or >= 0.55

preprocessingSensitivity.warning: Excluding same-school links in the published graph is a construction rule, not proof that institutional bias was removed. School-mean subtraction also removes real shared curriculum/context.

documentedInstitutionAlias.note: The supplied review identifies these as one institution. Data/IDs are not merged by this audit.

duplicateAndRepresentationWarnings.note: Repeated descriptions / legacy degree variants are not automatically duplicate programs. Entity reconciliation needs source review; no records or graph edges changed.

missingKnowledgeLayers.booksProjectsTheoriesAlumniCareers: No structured, evidence-linked layer for these entities is present in the audited program schema. Do not infer shared readings, alumni or careers from a program-similarity edge.

edgeLayers.documented: Official curriculum, reading list, project credit, faculty or alumni evidence. Keep exact claim, source passage, URL, scope, date and reviewer.
edgeLayers.editorial: Our interpretation / reading route. Clearly labelled, with an explanation and bibliography; not presented as the school's curriculum.
edgeLayers.computed: A candidate resonance from the versioned model. Not evidence of a shared book, theory, partnership or career.

learningGraphDirection.fusing: A user-held juxtaposition of two or more programs: show sourced intersections, contrasts and possible reading routes side by side. Preserve each identity; do not average vectors into a fit score or invent a hybrid degree.
learningGraphDirection.internalReadingPages: Bibliographic records, original explainers, source-backed teaching connections and licensed excerpts / full text when permission permits. One provenance drawer rather than a maze of external links.
learningGraphDirection.contentRights: Open bibliographic metadata does not grant rights to the underlying books, PDFs or images. Check per-work license before hosting content.
learningGraphDirection.alumni: Use explicit public / consented education, project and role records with dates and attribution. Faculty is not alumni; association is not causation. Coverage bias prevents credible career-success rankings.
learningGraphDirection.pilot: Curate a small, varied set of roughly 12 programs and 20 resources before scaling. Validate exact links with a human; empty or unknown is an acceptable result. No resources or alumni claims have been generated by this audit.

references.relevance: Evaluate local/global structure, parameter/preprocessing sensitivity and efficiency; do not treat projected clusters as ground truth. This paper does not validate our art-school graph.
Neighbor embeddings can introduce misleading structures; diagnostic evaluation is needed before adopting UMAP/t-SNE.
OpenAlex metadata is CC0; useful for bibliographic entities.
Original PDFs retain their own copyright; metadata openness does not grant full-text reuse rights.

validationRequired: Freeze source snapshots and canonical institution identities, preserving all legacy IDs as aliases.
Embed versioned program-specific curriculum text separately from school/location/admissions boilerplate; keep source quotes and text hashes.
Create a stratified human-reviewed set of within- and cross-subject pairs, including negatives, translations, sparse records and legacy variants; hold out a test set before choosing thresholds.

Compare content-only embeddings, a lexical baseline and sourced attribute overlap. Measure precision/coverage, robustness and projection neighborhood preservation; report uncertainty, not a fit score.
Keep affiliation, documented teaching/resources and computational resonance as separate typed edge layers. Show the evidence for every material claim.
